duration.text: The Chinese language training program at Guangdong University of Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: （1）A foreigner's ordinary passport valid for more than one year or a currently valid visa in China.(2) The highest academic degree certificate and the transcript of the complete study stage (original and notarized in Chinese or English).(3) Physical examination report (The examination results must have a valid official seal and be valid for 6 months).(4) There are additional materials to be supplemented as per the notice.

requirements.text: Foreign citizens who are physically and mentally healthy and of good conduct; No criminal record. Those who are under the age of 18 (as of the time of enrollment in the current year) must provide a valid guardian guarantee letter in China. During the study period in China, I voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations, respect Chinese social morality and customs, and refrain from engaging in any activities that are inconsistent with my student status.
